1:
Happy New Year, my love.
I’m so grateful we pushed through everything together—every hard moment,
every doubt, every lesson.
We’re still here, choosing each other,
and that means more than I can put into words. 
I would be endlessly blessed if I could 
spend the next forever with you,
growing, laughing, and loving side by side.
Here’s to us, and to all the years still waiting for us.

11:
Today felt lighter in the best way. 
Nine hours — from 9 in the morning until 6 in the evening — just hearing your voice, 
and somehow it still didn’t feel like enough. 

I had so much fun with you today. 
Laughing at little things, talking about nothing and everything, 
letting the hours pass without counting them. 
Your voice stayed with me even after we hung up, 
like a quiet warmth I didn’t want to shake off. It reminded me how natural it feels to exist alongside you, 
even from far away. 

Thank you for today. 
Thank you for your voice, your time, and the way you make hours disappear. 

Always, 
King
12:
Today was a quiet one. Not much really happened — 
my teeth hurt most of the day, and everything felt a little slower because of it. 
Still, even on a day like this, your presence made things easier. 
Just having you there, 
talking with you, 
sharing small moments, 
reminded me that comfort doesn’t always come from big events. 
Sometimes it’s simply company. 

Some days don’t need much to be meaningful. 
Today was one of those days — 
and you were the best part of it. 

Always, 
King
13:
Today was loud and full. 
I went out with my cousins to celebrate his birthday, 
and we stayed out all night laughing, eating, just enjoying the moment. 
It was genuinely fun — but even in the middle of all that noise, 
I kept thinking about you. 
I missed you the whole time. 

It’s funny how even when I’m surrounded by people, 
my heart still looks for you. 
I caught myself wishing I could tell you every little detail as it happened, 
wishing you were there in some way. 
Days like this remind me that no matter where I am or what I’m doing, 
you’re always with me — quietly, constantly, naturally.
14:
Today wasn’t perfect, 
and that’s okay. We had a small argument about our relationship, 
and for a moment it felt heavy. 
But what mattered most to me was that we didn’t run from it. 
We talked it through, listened to each other, 
and chose understanding over silence. 
I’m really grateful for that — for us. 
For the way we face things instead of letting them break us. 

After that, we spent the whole day calling, 
just staying connected, 
letting the tension soften into comfort. 
By the end of it, I felt closer to you than before. 
Days like this remind me that love isn’t about never arguing — 
it’s about choosing each other even when things aren’t easy.
15:
Today was simple and really happy. 
We called all day, and I had so much fun just asking you questions — 
the random ones, the curious ones, 
the ones that made me feel closer to you with every answer. 
I love learning you like that, little by little, 
in ways that feel natural and unforced. 

You needed to sleep early tonight, so we ended the day with a sleep call. 
There was something really comforting about that — 
knowing we were resting at the same time, even from far away. 
It felt peaceful, like ending the day exactly where I wanted to be: 
with you.
